_comment: Restroom sign manifest. PLACEHOLDER VALUES: the twelve icons are original SVG drawings made for this project (scripts/draw-restroom-samples.mjs), and every number under `mock` and `similarity` is invented so Compare and Match give stable, sensible demo results. They are what the mock provider returns, not model outputs. To use real IOAI images: put them in this folder, point `file` at them, and paste the real model outputs (gender, confidence) into `mock` and the real pair similarities into `similarity.pairs`. IOAI 2025 data is CC-BY-4.0: keep the attribution in web/README.md and on the About page.

similarity._comment: Mock similarity, the same 0..1 scale as the model ((cos + 1) / 2). Two signs of one set get sameSet[set]. Two signs of different sets get crossSet['a|b'] (set ids in alphabetical order) or defaultCross, plus a fixed jitter of at most ±jitter derived from the two sample ids, so values look less uniform but never change. `pairs` overrides everything for a specific pair ('idA|idB', alphabetical).
